name: Gatekeeper CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  validate-and-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      checks: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Setup Godot
        uses: chickensoft-games/setup-godot@v1
        with:
          version: 4.2.1 # Match your local version
          use-dotnet: true

      - name: Build Project
        run: dotnet build

      - name: Run Tests (GdUnit4)
        id: test_step
        # Assumes you have the GdUnit4 CLI or runner configured. 
        # For simplicity in this PoC, we run the project in headless test mode.
        run: godot --headless --build-solutions --run-tests --quit-on-finish

      - name: Auto-Merge on Success
        if: success()
        run: gh pr merge "${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}" --merge --auto
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post Failure Comment
        if: failure()
        run: |
          gh pr comment "${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}" --body "❌ Tests Failed. Check the logs and fix the code."
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
